title: Call to Allow Airbnb in Singapore
what_it_is: Call to Allow Airbnb in Singapore

sections.label: Short-term accommodation safeguards and controls
sections.summary: Discussions suggest scope to allow short-term accommodations in Singapore with safeguards, and regulatory parameters will be worked out and publicly consulted before finalising.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, from these discussions, we believe there is scope to allow short-term accommodations in Singapore, subject to proper safeguards and controls.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We are working out these regulatory parameters and will consult the public on the proposed measures before finalising them.
